claims: Kevin Durant is out for Game 1 of the 2026 NBA playoffs.
Game 1 of the 2026 NBA playoffs is Rockets vs. Lakers.
Kevin Durant sustained a right knee injury during practice on Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
Kevin Durant's right knee injury is a contusion in the patellar tendon area.
Kevin Durant's right knee injury caused tenderness.
Kevin Durant's right knee injury caused limited movement.
Rockets coach Ime Udoka labeled Kevin Durant day-to-day.
Rockets coach Ime Udoka hopes it is only a one-game absence.
